sponsorsPage.partnersBody: Behind every matchup are brands supporting the sport. Meet the partners who stand with UFP.

sponsorsPage.physicalNote: These prices cover placements on ufpcombat.com only. Social media posts, canvas branding, live mentions, tickets, hospitality and on-site activations are quoted separately.
sponsorsPage.formKicker: Digital campaign prices · No online payment
sponsorsPage.discoverBody: Your brand along the fan journey: the home page, event fight card and partner directory.
sponsorsPage.storyBody: A space for your identity, your offer and what makes your business special, using content confirmed by your brand.
sponsorsPage.connectBody: Once you share your official destination, fans can go from discovering your brand to visiting your website or profile.
sponsorsPage.campaignTerms: One payment for {days} days of digital presence around the event. The start date is agreed when booking; there is no automatic renewal.
